N3: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (/assignee/login !| "unassigned") | groupBy | * count`

N4: `:d1 (at :dependencies | coalesce {} | entries) | :d2 (at :devDependencies | coalesce {} | entries) | [d1 d2] | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0 | sort | * (keyword)`

N5: `/services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) | {:enabledCount (count) :ports (* (/1 | at :port | coalesce null) | filter ~(type | ne ::null) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (* (/1 | at :replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}`

N8: `(:login (filter ~(/type | lower | eq "login") | * /user | distinct) | :logout (filter ~(/type | lower | eq "logout") | * /user | distinct) | login | minus logout | sort)`

N9: `filter ~((at :salary | type | ne ::null)) | groupBy ~/dept | * (/ | {:sum (* /salary | sum) :count (count)} | apply ~(div /sum /count) | round 1)`

N10: `lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ":" | /1 | split "," | * (split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | /0 | lower) | distinct) | flat | distinct | sort`

N11: `["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","apple","date"] | * (lower) | groupBy | * count | entries | filter ~(/1 | gt 1) | * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word])`

N13: `filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | {:count (count) :allPriced (every ~(if (/price | type | ne ::null) ~(if (/price | gt 0) ~(true) ~(false)) ~(false))) :inStockNames (filter ~(/stock | gt 0) | * /name | sort)}`
